results.content: The economy was Trump's second-strongest issue when he took office. Today it ranks among his weakest. The Silver Bulletin average shows his net approval on the economy at positive 6 points on January 21, 2025, briefly rising above positive 8 points in late January. By August 20, 2026, it had fallen to negative 28.3 points. Net approval on cost of living and inflation specifically started even lower, at negative 6 points, and has since fallen to negative 42.7 points. Trump’s approval rating on tariffs – as well as on his handling of inflation – lag behind his overall approval rating.
